title: New River Valley flood
summary: A hypothetical flood modeled on September 27, 2024, when the remnants of Hurricane Helene pushed the New River to major flood stage and evacuations were reported in Montgomery, Pulaski and Giles counties. The places and programs shown are real; the situation is a demonstration.

when.response: This is a hypothetical replay of September 27, during the flood.
when.recovery: It is weeks after the flood; the user is recovering.

resource_notes.response: No shelters are listed for this hypothetical flood. In a real flood, call 2-1-1 or check the Red Cross for open shelters.
resource_notes.recovery: Call ahead to confirm hours before you go.
resource_notes.empty: No places of that kind are listed for this scenario. Call 2-1-1 for current options.

recorded_alerts.title: Major flooding on the New River
recorded_alerts.headline: USGS warned of major flooding impacts in the New River basin in southwest Virginia.
recorded_alerts.description: Mainstem New River sites were expected to peak at major flood stage from Saturday into Sunday morning.

recorded_alerts.title: Evacuations in seven counties
recorded_alerts.headline: Residents in seven Virginia counties, including Montgomery, Pulaski and Giles, evacuated as the New River flooded.
recorded_alerts.description: Reported by WVTF from a state statement. Follow local officials' instructions in a real event.
